origin.description: Add the elements of a numeric vector, pausing after each one and optionally reporting progress.
origin.usage: slow_sum_p(x, delay = getOption("progressr.demo.delay", 1.0), stdout = getOption("progressr.demo.stdout", FALSE), message = getOption("progressr.demo.message", TRUE), sticky = getOption("progressr.demo.sticky", TRUE), progress = getOption("progressr.demo.progress", TRUE))

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector to sum. An integer vector keeps integer storage.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.text: Seconds to pause, split into five sleeps of 0.2 * delay after each element. The default reads progressr.demo.delay, or 1.0 when that option is unset.

arguments.name: stdout
arguments.text: If TRUE, print O: Element #k for the 1-based index. When the argument is omitted, progressr.slow_sum_p.stdout replaces the demo default.

arguments.name: message
arguments.text: If TRUE, signal M: Added value for each element. When omitted, progressr.slow_sum_p.message replaces the demo default.

arguments.name: sticky
arguments.text: If TRUE, signal a sticky progression every 10 elements. When omitted, progressr.slow_sum_p.sticky replaces the demo default.

arguments.name: progress
arguments.text: If TRUE, create a progressor along x. Otherwise the reporter does nothing. When omitted, progressr.slow_sum_p.progress replaces the demo default.

origin.details: Each element signals an alive update, sleeps, optionally prints, sleeps, signals alive again, sleeps, adds the element, signals P: Adding with the 1-based index, sleeps, optionally messages the value, signals alive again, and sleeps. A sticky update uses class sticky. An explicit FALSE does not read the hidden option.
origin.value: The sum. Integer x returns an integer.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.text: Seconds to pause, split into five sleeps of 0.2 * delay after each element. Omitted reads progressr.demo.delay, or 1.0 when that option is unset.

arguments.name: stdout

arguments.name: message
arguments.text: If True, signal M: Added value for each element. Omitted reads progressr.slow_sum_p.message.

arguments.name: sticky
arguments.text: If True, signal a sticky progression every 10 elements. Omitted reads progressr.slow_sum_p.sticky.

arguments.name: progress
arguments.text: If True, create a progressor along x. Otherwise the reporter does nothing. Omitted reads progressr.slow_sum_p.progress.

translation.details: The loop matches R, including the five partial sleeps, the alive progress(amount=0) updates, the P: Adding message for the 1-based index, and the sticky update with class_. Set progressr.enable true before a progressor if the check records events. An omitted argument is the sentinel, not False.
translation.value: The sum. Integer input returns an int.
translation.example:
from progressr.condition import condition_message, try_invoke_restart, with_calling_handlers
from progressr.demo import slow_sum_p
from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.factory import make_progression_handler
from progressr.options import set_option

set_option("progressr.enable", True)
lines = []

def update(config, state, progression, **kwargs):
    text = condition_message(progression).replace("\n", "")
    if text:
        lines.append(text)

handler = make_progression_handler("rec", reporter={"update": update}, enable=True, target="file", interval=0)

def on_message(condition):
    lines.append(condition_message(condition).replace("\n", ""))
    try_invoke_restart("muffleMessage", condition)

def body():
    return slow_sum_p(list(range(1, 4)), delay=0, stdout=False, message=True, sticky=False, progress=True)

value = with_calling_handlers(
    lambda: with_progress(body, handlers=handler, enable=True, interval=0, delay_terminal=False, delay_stdout=False, delay_conditions=()),
    message=on_message,
)
print(f"slow_sum_p(1:3) returns {value}.")
print("\n".join(lines))
